merge backend   : pyramid (default)

iso             : 500

                  camera's own white level, which checks one relation and is not a PTC; the
                  PTC now exists and the relation survives it at true gain steps -- the ISO 160
                  control measures 0.3273 DN/e- against the relation's 0.3663, 10.7% low.
                  READ NOISE: not photon-transfer measured. DERIVED from dark frames, and below
                  ISO 400 it carries a shape error `profile.rs` asserts rather than hides.
                  This is a PROFILE, NOT A PER-BODY CALIBRATION: the constants describe the
                  camera MODEL and nothing here was fitted from this stack. Below the profile's
                  base ISO the sensor reads out at base-ISO gain (extended/pull ISO); that floor
                  is measured, but the ISO at which it starts is not (SYNTHESIS question 126
                  -- the corpus holds no ISO 64 or 80 capture).
defect map      : off (STREHL_DEFECT=off)
frames          : 63 from D:\personal\macro\113MSDCF  (first decode 0.10 s)
planes          : 3516 x 2344 per CFA plane
--- the merge ---
bands           : 7 Laplacian levels + 1 base, coarsest 28 x 19
selection       : SOFT -- weight = (band power above the noise floor)^exponent, a convex combination.
                  Sign coherence is free: a convex combination cannot take adjacent
                  coefficients from opposite-signed frames, which is the ringing a
                  coefficient-wise argmax produces.
noise gate      : 2.00 x the modelled band-noise power. Below it, NO frame may win and the
                  merge averages -- which is the correct estimator when there is no
                  information, and the only operation that gets below single-frame noise.
exponent        : 2.00
per-band exp    : 2 3 4 5 8 8 8   (coarsest -> finest)
                  sharpness ramps 1.4x per octave toward the fine bands. A wrong pick in a
                  fine band is one high-frequency coefficient nobody can see; a wrong pick
                  in a coarse band IS the rim.
base band       : plain mean across frames
not applied     : photometric gain, clip census, outlier rejection, halo correction, through-focus
                  statistics. Those are the --merge estimator path's stages; this arm is the merge only.
align: track prior on, lambda=1 huber=Some(1.0) px
alignment       : ON (solved), reference frame 31, 63 placed / 0 refused, 10.9 s
  held-out err  : NOT MEASURED   resampler: CatmullRom
  coverage      : field of view scaled to 0.9809 so that EVERY frame covers every pixel (1.9% of width dropped, then upsampled to keep the output dimensions).
memory plan     : 4 workers x 1328 MB = 5.2 GB against a 6144 MB budget, CONSTANT in
                  the frame count. The merge is a fold: every accumulator is a sum, so a
                  frame is built, added and dropped. STREHL_PYRAMID_WORKERS=N overrides.

folded          : 63 / 63 frames in 34.7 s (0.55 s per frame, 4 workers)
band noise gain : 0.8898 0.0529 0.0101 0.0024 0.0006 0.0001 0.0000 0.0000
